entities.name: Arginine-tRNA ligase
observations: The 584-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to curated UniProt A1R025; annotated as cytoplasmic and monomeric.
Curated homologs show EC 6.1.1.19, arginine-tRNA ligase activity, ATP binding, and arginyl-tRNA aminoacylation.
Pfam domains: Arg_tRNA_synt_N (PF03485), tRNA-synt_1d (PF00750), and DALR_1 (PF05746).

entities.name: Arginyl-tRNA formation
observations: Rhea RHEA:20301: tRNA(Arg) + L-arginine + ATP = L-arginyl-tRNA(Arg) + AMP + diphosphate.
This is the aminoacylation reaction catalyzed by arginine-tRNA ligase; ATP is consumed and cleaved to AMP plus diphosphate.

entities.name: ArgRS sequence properties
observations: The query protein is 584 residues with calculated molecular mass 67,355 Da and theoretical pI 9.09.
These are sequence-derived estimates and do not account for ligands, modifications, or oligomerization.

entities.name: Arginyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: The protein is annotated with GO biological process GO:0006420, arginyl-tRNA aminoacylation.
